en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said to himasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! There is a neighbour of mine who is frequent of the Salāt, and of frequent charity, and frequents the Hajj. There is no problem with him’. So heasws said: ‘O Is’haq! How is his intellect?’ I said to himasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! There is no intellect for him’. So heasws said: ‘(His deeds) would not benefit (to raise his status) him due to that’.
